senses.gloss: m. (קָוַץ) one with curled hair, opp. קרח bald-headed.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2:10">Y. Shek. III, 47ᶜ</cite> <he>ק׳ לא יתרום וכ׳</he> a curly-headed person must not handle the Temple treasure on account of suspicion (that he may hide coins in his hair), v. <cite ref="Q01345"><he>פִּסְפֵּס</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>קִיוְּוצִים</he>, <cite ref="S00882"><he>קִוְּו׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 796:4">Yalk. Ps. 796</cite> <he>מלך … כמה ק׳ כיוצא בו</he> when a human king marches to the camp, how many are there, handsome like him, curly-haired like him!—[<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 343:12">Sifré Deut. 343</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00264"><he>קָווּץ</he></cite>.]
